buttons.notes: Official spec confirms these two are the DPI Minus/Plus buttons, not generic 'top controls'; left-to-right physical order (whether G6 or G7 is Minus) is unconfirmed.

notes: The mapping is a conservative physical description for legacy discovery, not an authorization to write unknown macro records.
The product ID was inherited from a combined G9/G9x descriptor and has not been independently re-verified against a real device.

DPI maximum corrected 5000 -> 3200: libratbag's logitech-g9.device declares DpiList=200;400;600;800;1000;1200;1400;1600;1800;2000;2200;2400;2600;2800;3000;3200 for 0xC048 -- 5000 is not in that list and appears to have been conflated with the G9x successor (which itself tops at 5700, not 5000 either).

G6/G7 relabeled 2026-09-17 from generic 'Top control' to 'DPI down'/'DPI up': official Logitech G9 Technical Specifications page lists 'DPI Settings Buttons: Minus (-), Plus (+)'. Also per that page, a bottom-mounted profile button and the wheel's FreeSpin/Ratchet mode-shift lever exist on the physical device but are not counted among these 7 profile-array records (CHECK: unconfirmed whether the mode-shift is a mechanical-only lever or a HID button that simply isn't in this array).
